_comment: The hand-written half. Edit this daily; fetch-data.mjs merges it with FRED and never overwrites it.
summary: The US hadn't attacked Iran in over a month. That ended yesterday — they're attacking each other again, which is why oil prices are back up. Or better yet, not going down. Expect inflation expectations to continue increasing, causing the treasury yields to not simmer down. Warsh might (should) hike. Bessent's hands are tied, trying to conduct monetary policy with a fiscal toolbox. Current debt is not sustainable longterm. AI Capex helping economic growth, but lots of data center roadblocks (energy grid + returns). Stagflation in the horizon? Interesting times.
